newsitem.title: JAPAN: India buys two Dubai, others in tender - traders.
newsitem.headline: India buys two Dubai, others in tender - traders.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) awarded at least two Dubai cargoes and possibly four West African crude cargoes in its July buying tender, traders said on Friday.
Traders said they believe the IOC bought two parcels of July-loading Dubai from a U.S. trader, one at first-half month quotes plus 31 cents and another at first-half month quotes plus 33 cents.
The IOC is believed to have also purchased Escravos, Qua Iboe and two parcels of Gulf of Suez, traders said.
The volumes of the West African grades are all Very Large Crude Carriers (VLCCs) with the exception of one of the two Gulf of Suez cargoes which was said to be about 800,000 barrels in volume.
The Escravos was sold at Dated Brent plus 98 cents by a U.S. major and the Qua Iboe from a different U.S. major at dated Brent plus $1.00 or $1.16, traders said.
A Swiss trader was reported to have sold the 800,000-barrel Gulf of Suez cargo at a premium of 33 cents above the official selling price.
The second Gulf of Suez cargo was believed to have been sold by a French major at dated Brent minus $1.90, traders said.
The details of the tender awards could not be immediately confirmed with the successful sellers.
